description: This Java class 'DefaultMessageConfig' provides configuration for message timeouts within the Eclipse Ditto gateway service. It encapsulates default and maximum timeout durations, constructed from a scoped configuration, and implements equals, hashCode, and toString methods for object comparison and representation.

classes.name: DefaultMessageConfig
classes.description: Immutable class implementing MessageConfig interface, managing message timeout configurations.
